notes: 19 paragraph-level historical claim references with direct URLs, source passage locators, access scopes and limitations. The declared Indonesian independence date (17 August 1945) is distinguished from Dutch transfer of sovereignty (27 December 1949). War crimes research uses NIOD’s synopsis; it does not claim full archival review. The Partition boundary and migration discussion draws on both British and Indian institutional records, an open scholarly introduction, and an oral-history project overview; death tolls are deliberately not supplied as settled statistics. The Vietnamese telegram and dates are documented in a U.S. archive exhibit; Vietnamese official commemoration is labeled accordingly. No duration target.

description: Compares Indonesia’s 1945 independence declaration and the 1949 transfer of sovereignty, India’s and Pakistan’s 1947 partition and its mass displacement, and Vietnam’s 1945 proclamation followed by renewed war with France.
